story.title: I wasn't always this woman.
paragraphs: Thirteen years ago my life looked perfect from the outside — but inside, I was falling apart. My body was breaking down. My life felt unbearable. I was disconnected from myself, trapped in patterns I couldn't understand, drowning in a job I hated — and I had been told I would probably never become a mother.
Then I chose to burn my old life down. I healed. I became a mother — twice. I found my purpose. And I discovered how to see the hidden roots beneath the patterns that keep us stuck.

My own breakdown became the doorway to my life's work. Today I help others uncover what lies beneath — so they can stop repeating what hurts, reconnect with who they are, and create the life they came here to live.

items: Losing yourself in a relationship just to keep it alive?
Dreading Mondays because your work is draining the life out of you?
Feeling lost in a life that looks fine — but feels completely empty?
Going from one struggle to the next while your body keeps paying the price?

story.title: How the Unblock Method™ was born
paragraphs: For years I did everything you are supposed to do. I went to doctors. I read the books. I tried the therapies and the practices and the protocols. Each one helped a little, and none of them explained the thing that kept happening: the same pattern, coming back in a new costume.
A different relationship, the same ending. A different job, the same exhaustion. A different diagnosis, the same underlying feeling that something in me was quietly working against me.
The turning point wasn't a technique. It was a question. I stopped asking “How do I fix this?” and started asking “Why is this happening in the first place?”

That question changed the direction of my whole life. It took me into timeline healing, ancestral work, shadow work, inner-child healing and subconscious transformation — and eventually into the work I do now, which is simply this: I look at what is actually there, I name it, and together we release it.
I called it the Unblock Method™ because that is honestly what it does. It does not manage symptoms. It finds the block, follows it to its root, and lets it go.

turning.title: Diagnosis first. Always.
paragraphs: Most healing work starts with a solution and hopes it fits. I start with a diagnosis. Before we change anything, we find out what is actually there — which block, from which layer, carried since when, and for whom.

Some of what we find belongs to you. A surprising amount of it never did. Inherited loyalty, an old family contract, a decision made by a frightened seven-year-old who is still, somewhere in your nervous system, making decisions on your behalf.
My job is to make the invisible visible, and then to help you put down what was never yours to carry.

items.q: Can I book on behalf of someone else?

Ultimately, the person receiving the gift gets to decide whether and when they want to use it.

Absolutely. The content of our sessions, therapy and the work we do together is strictly confidential and will never leave the room. I will never repeat, share, quote or use anything you tell me.
